pkgmetadata.longdescription:
h5i gives an AI coding agent a disposable, policy-enforced environment — workspace, shell, dependencies, dev server and browser inside one security boundary — and produces reviewable patches and execution logs showing what changed, what ran and what was denied. It is local-first: no hosted sandbox and no SaaS account.
Five confinement tiers, strongest last: workspace (a separate git worktree, no confinement), process (Landlock filesystem allowlist, seccomp deny-list, namespaces, rlimits), supervised (adds a private network namespace with an nftables egress allowlist and DNS pinning), container (rootless Podman, read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities) and microvm (a hardware-isolated guest with its own kernel).
h5i never silently downgrades: a request it cannot satisfy fails closed, so the process and supervised tiers need a kernel with CONFIG_SECURITY_LANDLOCK=y that also lists landlock in CONFIG_LSM.

use.flag: Build the dev-util/h5i box console (h5i ui): an axum server plus a React bundle embedded into the binary. Needs a Node toolchain at build time.
Pull in app-containers/podman for the rootless container confinement tier.
